image.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: professional hairstyle-analysis teaching image for a mobile training app
Primary request: Create a realistic 2-by-2 contact sheet showing the CURRENT hairstyle of one fictional adult East Asian woman from four consistent views: front, exact right profile, exact left profile, and exact back. This is not a makeover and not a before/after comparison.
Scene/backdrop: identical plain warm light-gray studio background in all four panels, no salon tools or props
Subject: the exact same woman in every panel, around early 30s, natural unretouched facial texture, neutral relaxed expression. Current hair is dark brown, medium-to-coarse looking, mostly straight with only a very slight natural bend at the ends, medium density, a jaw-to-upper-neck bob with a fairly continuous blunt lower edge, modest width through the lower sides, low/flat root lift at the crown, long open face-framing pieces, no short bangs. The shape should look somewhat firm and structured rather than airy or wavy. Show full head, complete hair outline and baseline, ears as naturally visible for the angle, full neck and both shoulders.
Clothing: identical simple muted sage-gray crew-neck top in all panels, no jewelry
Style/medium: honest photorealistic studio reference photography, realistic individual hair strands and skin texture, no beauty filter
Composition/framing: landscape contact sheet, four equal panels in a clean 2x2 grid; top-left front, top-right exact right profile, bottom-left exact left profile, bottom-right exact back; consistent camera height, scale, lens, crop, posture and lighting; shoulders level and centered
Lighting/mood: soft neutral diffused daylight, even exposure, no dramatic shadows
Constraints: same identity, proportions, hairstyle, hair length, clothing and lighting in every panel; show only the current haircut; no labels, no text, no arrows, no watermark; no simulated curls, no perm result, no styling comparison
Avoid: glamour retouching, skin smoothing, makeup changes, exaggerated face reshaping, inconsistent hair length or face between views, hidden neckline, cropped head, three-quarter views, duplicated front views, extra people, salon background
